statement: Lean certifies the 160-bit prime p, a nonsingular curve using the published corrected coefficient, an actual Mathlib point G of exact prime order p, and the actual fixed known-answer relation Q=dG. It also directly disproves the old preprint curve j=-32768 claim and checks the corrected curve j=-32768, consistently with the already published author erratum. This is not a Smart execution/cost theorem or a proof that the whole curve point count equals p.
